scripts.postbump: export V=$(jq -r .version crates/tauri-plugin-i18n-next/package.json) && perl -pi -e 's/^version = ".*"/version = "$ENV{V}"/' Cargo.toml && perl -pi -e 's/^(i18n-next = \{ version = "=)[^"]*/${1}$ENV{V}/' crates/tauri-plugin-i18n-next/Cargo.toml && cargo update --workspace && cargo update --workspace --manifest-path tools/size-probe/Cargo.toml && cargo test -p i18n-next --test version_sync && git add Cargo.toml Cargo.lock crates/tauri-plugin-i18n-next/Cargo.toml crates/tauri-plugin-i18n-next/package.json tools/size-probe/Cargo.lock
scripts.postchangelog: cp CHANGELOG.md crates/i18n-next/CHANGELOG.md && cp CHANGELOG.md crates/tauri-plugin-i18n-next/CHANGELOG.md && git add CHANGELOG.md Cargo.toml crates/i18n-next/CHANGELOG.md crates/tauri-plugin-i18n-next/CHANGELOG.md
